title: Giessen Stroke Registry
summary: The aim of the planned study project is to assess the current situation regarding the treatment of patients with stroke. Specifically, various treatment strategies are to be associated and correlated with clinical endpoints, mortality or functional outcome in order to generate arguments for or against individual aspects of therapy. The focus will be on unresolved treatment approaches in acute therapy (e.g. periprocedural management, such as blood pressure, blood glucose, temperature, or airway management, during recanalizing therapies) as well as in secondary prevention on the stroke unit or intensive care unit, such as starting point, mode, and dosage of antithrombotic therapies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age above 18
* Patient admitted for acute stroke (Stroke Unit or Intensive Care Unit)
* Informed Consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inclusion criteria not met
